---
mode: ask
description: 'Use when: producing structured root cause analysis for bug, incident, or regression with corrective and preventive actions.'
---

Follow the canonical [project context](../../.codex/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md). Separate evidence from hypotheses and do not claim causes that are not supported by the supplied case.

Lakukan root cause analysis untuk kasus berikut:

${input:case}

Format output:

- Problem statement
- Trigger event
- Technical root cause
- Contributing factors
- Why escaped detection
- Corrective actions (jangka pendek)
- Preventive actions (jangka panjang)
- Verification plan
